description:
I’m Dhananjay, an Engineering Admission Counsellor helping students across Maharashtra choose the right engineering colleges and branches based on their exam scores and interests.
I guide students through CAP rounds, cutoff analysis, and option filling, explaining each step in a simple and clear way.
My focus is on honest, practical guidance so students can avoid confusion and make informed decisions.
My aim is to make the engineering admission process easy, transparent, and stress-free for every student.
